name: jobscan-workspace
description: Root task bindings for the JobScan monorepo: canonical environment setup and checks run via npm scripts from the repository root.

scripts.check:build: cd jobscan && npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
scripts.check:mcp: cd jobscan-mcp && npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && npm test
scripts.check: npm run check:build && npm run check:unit && npm run check:full && npm run check:mcp
